about.title: Trust is our capital
body: The Assarain Group, part of the Said Salem Al Wahaibi (SSW) Group of Companies, is a trading and investment organisation based in Muscat. Since its inception in 1975 it has been part of business development across the Sultanate of Oman.

Its companies work in construction, manufacturing, national infrastructure, consumer products, food distribution, insurance and healthcare, and the Group has entered strategic collaborations with global companies including KONE, Savills, The Body Shop, Raymond, STRABAG and Alserkal.
more: The Group says most of its business entities hold ISO certifications, and that it remains dedicated to vertical and lateral progress, innovation, customer orientation and total quality management, and Omanization alongside global collaboration.
Recent press names Sheikh Salem bin Said Al Wahaibi as Chairman of Assarain Group. The founder, Colonel Said bin Salem Al Wahaibi, passed away in October 2020.

services.title: Four divisions
services.intro: The Group organises its companies into four divisions, as listed on assarain.com.

items.title: Manufacturing
items.text: Concrete products in Oman and the UAE, steel billets and thermoplastic sheet.

detail.intro: Assarain began making concrete products in 1984. Today the manufacturing arm runs concrete plants in Oman and Dubai, a steel mill at Rusayl and a plastics extrusion plant in Sohar.
body: ACP describes itself as one of the largest concrete product makers in Oman, with 11 plants across Oman and the UAE.
Modern Steel Mills recycles ferrous scrap into billets in an electric arc furnace, now over 160,000 tonnes a year.
Shamal Plastic and Gulf Acrylic extrude polycarbonate, acrylic and other sheets for customers in four continents.

items.title: Construction, Maintenance & Property
items.text: Contracting, property and facilities management, residences, consultancy and lifts.

detail.intro: The property arm builds, lets and looks after buildings: from AICC contracting to Hatat Complex, more than 2,000 managed units and KONE lifts.
body: Assarain International Contracting designs and builds residential, commercial and industrial buildings with its own plant and workshops.
Assarain Properties (Hay Al Rahbah) manages more than 2,000 units in Oman and the UAE.
Savills and Partners Oman advises on valuation, leasing and investment, and KONE Assarain installs and maintains elevators and escalators.

items.title: Retail & Consumer Services
items.text: Furnishing, insurance, The Body Shop, clinics, Raymond menswear and facility services.

detail.intro: The consumer companies meet people every day: in The Body Shop and Raymond stores, at Hatat clinics, with an insurance broker, or through Kalhat teams cleaning and landscaping buildings.
body: Assarain Furnishing, founded with the Group in 1975, designs and fits out interiors.
National Marketing & Trading has run The Body Shop in Oman since 1995; Assarain Textiles has worked with Raymond since 1990.
Hatat Specialty Clinics has served patients since 1990, and Kalhat employs more than 2,800 people in soft services.

items.title: Commercial Wholesale
items.text: FMCG and frozen-food distribution across Oman from a central Muscat facility.

detail.intro: Assarain Food Products distributes food brands across Oman with cold storage and more than 23 refrigerated trucks.
body: The company operates from a central facility in Muscat with sales locations in Sohar, Nizwa and Al Kamil.
It says it was the first FMCG distributor in Oman to earn ISO 22000:2018 food-safety certification.

items.title: Assarain Furnishing
items.text: Interior design, fabrication and fit-out since 1975, from partitions and joinery to imported furniture.
body: Established in 1975, at Assarain Furnishing LLC, we bring more than four decades of experience and expertise towards the design, fabrication and fitting of premium interior furnishings and furniture, and are dedicated towards beautifying the interiors of Oman.

Providing turnkey solutions to a consistently growing market, our company delivers a tremendous range of robust and customized interior solutions for all segments of industry and retail requirements. With a growing national and global distribution network, we offer inspirational designs, premium quality furnishings, innovative textures and refreshing colours.

In addition to providing specialized furnishing design and consulting services, our development of customized products knows no bounds, as we offer a plethora of products and services including furnishing and fittings, partition and false ceiling systems, flooring works, joinery works, imported loose and fixed furniture, mechanical, electrical & plumbing works, heating, ventilation & air conditioning systems, fire detection and interior firefighting equipment, telephone, data and structured cabling systems, sophisticated auditorium systems with integrated video conferencing, projection, audio and visual systems, as well as various signage services. Our company also offers building security and access control systems and takes care of health, safety and environment aspects in all the projects we undertake.

In addition, a modern, mechanized fabrication facility ensures all products are constructed according to set specifications and customizations as required. This unique combination of skills, experience and technology has allowed us to successfully implement a versatile range of interior fit-out and furnishing projects, including endeavours with the Diwan of Royal Court, various Government Ministries, Saud Bahwan Group, British Petroleum, British Gas, Weatherford, Schlumberger, ABB, Royal Sun Alliance Insurance, AXA Gulf Insurance, Denton SNR, National Bank of Oman, Qatar National Bank and Blue City and many other clients.

A state-of-the-art design studio allows our professional team of designers, draftsmen and specialists to conceptualize all elements of various furnishing projects with relentless precision. Periodic stringent quality checks help us to maintain high standards and set new benchmarks with every project that we undertake.

items.title: Assarain Insurance Services
items.text: Insurance broking: risk programmes, policy placement, portfolio and claims management.
body: We are among the largest, fastest growing insurance broking houses of Oman and we take pride in being recognized as a trusted and customer-centric company that blends excellence in service with affordability and quality.

We have established a concrete reputation for our unparalleled technical expertise, value and integrity towards our clients. Our company develops customized risk management programs and caters to the insurance requirements of a variety of individual clients, businesses and industries.

Many prestigious clients have entrusted us with their portfolios for the proactive and innovative risk management strategies we offer. We play an integral role in the development of the local industry and our business encompasses all facets of the insurance business spectrum from small, private entities to major industrial organizations.

With the utmost care and attention, each client is presented with specialized insurance consulting services where all elements of risk are identified and quantified, with critical recommendations on mitigation. We strive to create long-term value for our stakeholders through our strong business fundamentals and arecommitted to setting new benchmarks in the Omani insurance industry.

A proud member of the "Origin Oman" campaign set forth by the Public Establishment for Industrial Estates (PEIE), we are dedicated to the continuous contribution to the initiatives that aim to preserve and enhance the economic, human and natural vitality of the Sultanate of Oman.

items.title: The Body Shop Oman (NMTC)
items.text: National Marketing & Trading Co. has been the exclusive agent for The Body Shop in Oman since 1995.
body: Thrilled to be the sole representative of a globally recognized brand, our company National Marketing & Trading Co.LLC (NMTC) is the exclusive agent for The Body Shop International plc in the Sultanate of Oman. Founded in 1976 as a small business providing natural hair and skin care products, today we are a prominent and trusted global beauty brand which focuses on accentuating the innate beauty of people. The Body Shop revolutionized the cosmetic industry by introducing concepts of natural simplicity, eco-friendly packaging, innovative cosmetic design and development and promoted ethical consumerism. After being acquired by L'Oréal in 2006, we are in the process of further scaling up our vision.

Established in 1995 in Oman, we deliver the international prestige of The Body Shop to our valued customers through a perfect balance of traditional culture and cosmetic product innovation. Our commitment to excellence found expression when The Body Shop (Oman) won laurels on being awarded recognition by The Body Shop International plc, UK, as the country with the "Best Growth" across small and medium operations across the globe.

Holding strong to Omani values in social responsibility, the vast majority of our specialized beauty consultants are members of the local community, trained and mentored by international professionals to meet The Body Shop standards and requirements. Extensive training on skin-care, make-up and other product related aspects are given to our Omani staff and currently all of our shops have Omani sales attendants. Our The Body Shop operations are presently spearheaded by an Omani who joined us 21 years ago as a salesgirl!

In addition, our company goes above and beyond to promote our values in social responsibility by actively participating in various Ministry of Health programs dedicated to women and children. These programs allow our specialized consultants to interactively promote the importance of skin-care and other health, wellness and beauty concepts. We are also extremely active members in supporting the various causes of DAR AL ATA'A, the leading local charitable organization in Oman.

items.title: Hatat Specialty Clinics
items.text: Private clinics at Wadi Adai and Azaiba, each with a pharmacy. Established in 1990.
body: A vital industry in any scenario, healthcare plays a critical role in the well-being of a nation and its people. Established in the year 1990, our organization Hatat Specialty Clinics is a key component in the evolution of top-notch healthcare systems in the medicare map of the Sultanate of Oman. Staffed with a highly specialized team of expert physicians, well-trained nurses and ancillary team members, we are committed to upholding exceptional standards towards medical treatment and therapy, medical technology and pharmaceuticals.

As the first fully-computerized private medical clinic in the Sultanate of Oman, we align our services with international standards, offering expert medical attention in a wide range of disciplines including general medicine, pediatrics, gynecology, dermatology, cosmetology, cardiology, endocrinology, diabetology, gastroenterology, radiology, otolaryngology(ENT), physiotherapy, ophthalmology, orthopedics, dentistry, psychiatry, family medicine and immunization. We take pride in being a member of the Oman Society for Petroleum Services(OPAL).

At Hatat Polyclinic, we are proud to utilize the best in highly sophisticated diagnostic, laboratory and X-ray facilities to ensure that all patient tests are accurately and efficiently conducted. A dedicated and constantly upgraded computer system supports our competence. In addition, our facilities are equipped with the latest advancements in ultrasound technology to cater to obstetrics and gynaecological requirements, as well as cutting edge machinery in echocardiography and CSA technology to address all cardiology-related concerns. Along with all standard facilities for general medicine and surgery, our dedicated physiotherapy unit provides expert treatment of all sports-related and muscular-skeletal injuries, along with additional dedicated units for dental and ophthalmology procedures. Regular quality assurance programs ensure that our laboratory equipment is kept modernized.

Our clientele includes individual patients, leading organizations, embassies, hotels, airlines, banks and industrial corporations for treatments ranging from general medicine to specialist care and diagnostic investigation.

In addition to our general medical service, we offer various medical packages such as pre-employment medical, periodic medical, annual medical, seafarer medical and diving medical which match up to international standards. We are also one of the panel clinics offering migration medicals to USA, Canada, Australia and New Zealand.

We operate out of two branches at Hatat House – Wadi Adai and Zubair Commercial Complex – Azaiba. Both the centres are supported by pharmacies well-stocked with globally reputed pharmaceutical brands and cosmetic products. Our Hatat Pharmacies also cater to both in-house and external prescriptions, and focus on the recuperation and support of valued patients.

items.title: Assarain Textiles (Raymond)
items.text: Raymond menswear and tailoring in Oman, with a showroom on Ruwi High Street. Established in 1990.
body: Giorgio Armani once said, "Elegance is not standing out, but being remembered." Assarain Textiles LLC, in collaboration with the prestigious Raymond Limited of India, is always fresh in the memory of our valued customers for bringing in a complete range of premier men's clothing to the Sultanate of Oman and for catering to their impeccable sense of dressing with elegance and style. Established in 1990, we have always been offering the latest in global fashion trends by way of an affordable, practical and trusted clothing line that includes a wide spectrum of menswear. From exclusive formals to relaxed casuals, our Raymond showroom on Ruwi High Street is an established entity of high quality suits, shirts, trousers and fabrics, all bearing the world-renowned Raymond trademark of unsurpassed standards.

At Assarain Textiles, we have a diverse product range of many designs and colours of fabric and textiles to suit every age, occasion and style. Holding our own in-house design, fabrication and tailoring divisions, we employ a team of specialized master tailors and designers, each member exclusively trained by Raymond Limited fashion experts in India. Our employment of such finesse in expertise and execution, has ensured that our company also provides a wide range of uniforms for several airlines, hotels and sales personnel within Oman's booming service industry. Through our top-notch product range, we have always set new benchmarks for excellence in the Omani textile industry.

Our innovative designs are infused with superior quality and service, all backed by expert professionals: a simple formula that has allowed Assarain Textiles LLC to flourish over the past two and a half decades, and that will allow us to continue to grow hand in hand with the Sultanate of Oman.

items.title: Kalhat Services & Trading
items.text: Cleaning, pest control, waste removal and landscaping, with offices in Ruwi, Sohar and Salalah.
body: At Kalhat Services & Trading LLC, we are proud to be recognized as Oman's leading provider of industrial soft services.

We are backed by nearly four decades of experience in the provision of comprehensive cleaning, pest control, waste removal, landscaping and maintenance services. Moreover, the exclusive range of premium quality household and industrial cleaning products we offer, as well as wellness, hygiene, agricultural input and plant products which we import from Holland make us stand tall as market leaders.

As an ISO 9001:2008 Certified organization, we have earned the privilege of serving some of the most prestigious patrons in the region, including the Diwan of Royal Court, Majlis Oman, Bait Bahjat Al Andhar, Saud Bahwan Group Plaza, and various ministries & corporate houses across the Sultanate.

In addition to all-encompassing cleaning and landscaping services, we also provide a tremendous range of both household and industrial-grade cleaning products to the Sultanate of Oman. Stylish and elegant solutions towards traditional gardening and our garden trading services supply a wide range of attractive pots, planters and jars in an effort to satisfy a broad spectrum of client requirements ranging from contemporary designs to traditional Islamic themes.

Our company operates primarily out of a central Muscat-based facility, and we also hold a well-connected network of strategic sales locations in Sohar, Nizwa and Al Kamil, with a total combined storage capacity of 1,250 metric tons.

Our vast operational processes, which include state of the art cold storage facilities, supplemented by a fleet of over 23 refrigerated trucks , enable us to offer efficient storage, transportation and distribution of products to all our customers in the Sultanate. Locally owned and operated, we are dedicated to supporting and promoting traditional Omani culture, values and heritage.

items.title: Assarain Concrete Products (ACP)
items.text: The Group's flagship: blocks, interlocking tiles, kerbstones and landscape products since 1984.
body: Assarain Concrete Products & Trading LLC (ACP) is a flagship company of the Assarain Group & is renowned for its brand and impeccable quality products and services across Oman & throughout the Gulf Region.

Originally established in 1984, we now lead the way as one of the largest manufacturers and suppliers of concrete products in Oman with our annual production capacities yielding 15 million concrete blocks, 3 million square meters of interlocking tiles, and 1.5 million linear meters of kerbstones. Our plant in Sohar is known as Modern Concrete Products (MCP) and the one in Dubai is known as Alserkal & Assarain Concrete Products (AACP).

Over the past three decades, we have grown into a prestigious "concrete products manufacturing group" by having additional mega manufacturing facilities in Sohar and Dubai. Modern Concrete Products-Sohar caters to the entire Al Batinah region whereas Alserkal – Assarain Concrete Products-Dubai supplies our wide range of products within the UAE markets. Our Group places the concrete products manufacturing companies in close focus as it forms the heart of our collective success.

A single source for a tremendous variety of products, we provide near limitless customized options to our available product range. Interlocking tiles, hydraulically pressed kerbstones, hydraulically pressed chamfered edge paving slabs, hydraulically pressed cable tiles, OPC and SRC building blocks, concrete patterned tiles and exposed aggregate tiles are among the key products offered by us that can be further customized towards specific customer requirements. In addition, specialized products are also available through our manufacturing facility such as surface shot blasted interlocking tiles, split finish blocks, rubber tiles, LED stone illumination tiles, light weight blocks, flower wall systems and retaining wall systems.

As part of our cumulative offering, we have exclusive agencies for the supply of smart construction solutions such as Tensar wall retaining systems, play equipment, LED lit pavers, & rubber tiles for playgrounds among many others.

We recognize the importance of "In-Country Value" and have assumed an integral role in the growth of our nation. A multi-phased strategy has been implemented to provide meaningful growth and Omanization across all of our operations. The work we have done has generated revenue and profit for the Sultanate, which in turn benefits business development, contributes to human capability and stimulates productivity in the Omani economy. We fully support the national ICV programme and have embedded ICV into our own business planning model. Through this, we aim to espouse our Group's specific initiatives that cover the development of a local workforce, the increase in local sourcing of raw materials, goods and services and our participation in Oman's Joint Supplier Registration System (JSRS). This further validates the ICV core value. Our ongoing commitment to Oman has grown to become a fundamental pillar in the ACP mission as our organization looks forward to sustained growth alongside the Sultanate.
We are the proud recipient of the "Best Manufacturer in Construction Material – Concrete Products Award" at the Construction Awards & Summit 2014.

We have also received awards from Yanqul Municipality towards corporate social responsibility (CSR) for supplying 10,000 sq. meters of interlocking tiles, free of cost, towards Yanqul's city development. Our company has received appreciation certificates from multiple customers such as Muscat and Sohar Municipalities.

Through offering exceptional product lines at highly competitive prices, we have grown to be recognized as an industry leader in the manufacture and provision of versatile interlocking tiles, cable tiles, high density polystyrene insulation blocks and high quality basic building blocks, all available in a variety of different combinations, designs and colours to facilitate a diverse range of client requirements.

Equipped with an arsenal of advanced technology, we were one of the initial companies in the region to produce concrete products through the use of an integrated MASA XL Plant. In addition, our highly experienced, competent and well-trained workforce contributes to all facets of general operations and management of our company's production and service. As qualified specialists in the industry, we are able to maintain a core philosophy founded on a strong work ethic, superior quality and innovation. Continuous devotion to these values is manifested in the ongoing development of advanced products and construction solutions.

Our company enjoys a trusted and prestigious brand name in the building and construction industry for the durability, long service and the permanence our products offer. As a loyal contributor to the constant development of the Al Batinah region, we are proud to serve as a frontrunner in construction and infrastructure projects and put in sustained efforts towards literally building a 'stronger' Sultanate. With an enduring commitment to teamwork, quality and service at Modern Concrete Products LLC, we strive to remain a leading concrete products manufacturer for the region and beyond.

body: Alserkal & Assarain Concrete Products (AACP) is a joint venture between Assarain Concrete Products & Trading LLC, Oman & M/s Nasser Bin Abdullatif Alserkal Est, UAE.

We offer a diverse range of interlock pavers, concrete blocks, hydraulically pressed kerbstones, custom kerbs, paving slabs, roof slabs, cable tiles and covers for a variety of applications in both urban and interior areas in the UAE.

Catering to various Dubai Government Bodies, contracting companies and specialized clientele, we have been market leaders for over three decades, implementing state-of-the-art technology and experience to offer a multitude of innovative, high quality products. We also offer attractive landscaping products, creatively designed planters, benches, litter bins, park equipment and much more as part of the iconic backdrop for the UAE.

We utilize an immense, high capacity, advanced German plant to manufacture these superior quality concrete products. The plant is equipped with a MASA 9001XL Block Manufacturing System for the production of high density concrete blocks. These include Hollow, Solid, Hourdi and Insulated Blocks, as well as high density, abrasion-resistant interlocking paving tiles. Our manufacturing facility is equipped to produce up to 7 million masonry blocks and 1.5 million square meters of interlocking tiles per year, all within a wide variety of colours, sizes, shapes, finishes and textures.

We are proud to be recognized as one of the few concrete product suppliers with Integrated Management System (IMS) Certification. Reflecting international recognition for our management procedures, processes and customer focus, the IMS Certification represents the way we prioritize Quality, Environmental and Occupational Health & Safety Systems and ensure that we implement and sustain them in all processes throughout our organization. These measures, which outline stringent quality standards, ensure that our products align with the requirements in place for Dubai's superior levels of design and construction.

In addition to this, the Dubai Central Laboratories Department (DCLD) has accredited our AACP Laboratory Facilities as a self-certifying company, the first of its kind with such a distinction. Proud to be a leader and a favoured company, our organization Alserkal & Assarain Concrete Products is continually reinforcedwith the relentless supply of new ideas, technology and initiatives to not merely the UAE and the Middle East Region, but also the rest of the world.

items.title: Modern Steel Mills (MSM)
items.text: Mild and alloy steel billets made from recycled scrap in an electric arc furnace at Rusayl. Since 2001.
body: We, at Modern Steel Mills LLC (MSM) take pride in being Oman's prominent steel company and are the leading suppliers of trusted and quality steel products in all major markets. With steel often acting as one of the core foundations of all industrial sectors, our company has introduced a superior level of innovation in the competitive world of steel manufacturing. What sets us apart is not just the magnitude of our company's operations or the superiority of the products we offer; it is our innovative approach towards the manufacture of safe and sustainable steel and the commitment of our workforce as we continually strive towards setting benchmarks in excellence and creating value for our customers and our nation.

Specializing in the manufacture of various types of mild steel and alloy steel billets, we provide a critical contribution to the essential raw materials required for infrastructure development. Established in 2001 at the Rusayl Industrial Estate, our organization Modern Steel Mills LLC manufactures steel billets utilizing advanced Electrical Arc Furnace technology.

Originally operating with an annual capacity of 84,000 metric tons, our operations have grown to currently produce over 160,000 metric tons per annum, with efforts directed towards products distributed across both Oman and the U.A.E.
Our operations are extremely environmentally friendly, converting waste ferrous scrap into an intermediary product that can be used as raw materials in rerolling mills.

Manufactured billets are used for rebar, wire rods, angles, channels and girders, along with a tremendous amount of other components utilized in the rapidly advancing construction industry. Being the first in the Sultanate to use Electrical Arc Furnace technology, our operations are extremely environmentally friendly, converting waste ferrous scrap into an intermediary product that can be used as raw materials in rerolling mills. These unique innovations, along with a strict adherence to quality assurance, health and safety, uphold our reputation as an exclusive supplier in quality steel products.

body: We are a shared endeavour between the Assarain Group, Zubair Group, Mohsin Haider Darwish Group, OmniVest and Oman Arab Bank. Established in 2001 within the Sohar Industrial Estate, we are a driving and thriving force in the GCC region as we cater to the requirements of customers across Europe, Asia Pacific, Africa and the Middle East.
Equipped with two ultramodern thermoplastic extrusion lines supplied by Omipa of Italy, we utilize the latest in fabrication technology as we conform to international standards.

These two lines are capable of processing a tremendous range of polymer products including Polycarbonate (PC), Acrylic (PMMA), Thermoplastic (ABS), Polystyrene (PS), High Impact Polystyrene (HIPS) and Thermoplastic Polymer (PET-G). Additionally, the extrusion lines are capable of producing co-extruded sheets, combining qualities of two polymers in order to manufacture unique products tailored specifically towards distinctive client requirements.

With an annual capacity of 7,200 metric tons, our plant along with its state of the art technology is contributing to bringing about exponential growth in the operational facilities of Shamal Plastic Industries LLC and Gulf Acrylic Industries LLC. Our highly skilled and well-trained local and multinational workforce, equipped with strong domain expertise, guarantees quality service and technical assistance for projects and ensures that all our products maintain the highest levels of superior quality at all times and orders are executed on schedule, each time.

We have successfully completed numerous projects for a wide variety of prominent organizations which range from government ministries to leading commercial establishments and high quality residential apartments for the private sector. items.title: Hatat Complex
items.text: Two buildings with 180 apartments and over 13,000 m² of commercial space, close to Sultan Qaboos Highway.
body: One of the first of its kind in Oman, with its distinctive functional and aesthetic appeal, the Hatat Complex is home to residences and offices of corporate multinationals, local companies and tenants. Our two magnificent buildings, Hatat Complexes A and B comprise a total of 180 luxury residential apartments as well as over 13,000 square metres of prime commercial space in a much preferred location.

At par with world-class standards, our residential property at the Hatat Complex offers a unique blend of affordable luxury and comfort along with excellent facilities. All deluxe apartments are equipped with air-conditioning units, latest amenities and a fully fitted modern kitchen. Spacious two and three bedroom suites range from 163 m2 to 234 m2, each consisting of a bright, spacious living room with bedrooms overlooking the surrounding scenic landscape. Access to state-of-the-art recreational facilities that include two swimming pools, steam rooms, tennis courts, squash courts, facilities for indoor games such as table tennis, snooker and table hockey, as well as a children's play area is also offered to the residents of Hatat Complex.

All commercial units within the Hatat Complex offer an inspiring, modern and professional atmosphere for prospective long-term business tenants. Each property unit holds centralized air conditioning, glazed windows, false ceilings, suspended light fittings, tiled flooring, along with telephone and electrical access points. Our current commercial tenants include banks, auditors, lawyers, consultants, insurance brokers and travel agents. Also located onsite is an advanced medical polyclinic, saloon, pharmacy and coffee shop.

With the utmost convenience of residents and visitors in mind, the Hatat Complex has the provision of a total of 720 parking spaces consisting of both underground and shaded, aboveground units. The facilities of a 24-hour maintenance and security presence, upkeep of air conditioning, pest control, water, sewage, satellite, appliances and electrical systems is carried out in a systematic manner at frequent intervals. Added aspects of convenience are the easy access to the Sultan Qaboos Highway and various landmarks such as City Center Qurum, Sultan Centre, Al Qurum Complex, Al Araimi Complex and Lulu Hypermarket. We are always ready to welcome new enquiries from both residential and commercial prospects.

body: Our Company Hay Al Rahbah Trading & Contracting Co. LLC was established in 1995 as an effort to consolidate all the real estate projects of the Assarain Groupand to enhance operational efficiency through the streamlining of group initiatives.

Today, we are one of the largest facility management organizations within the Sultanate of Oman, currently holding over 2,000 units under our direct management across both the Sultanate and the United Arab Emirates. We offer a plethora of services covering purchase, rent and management of all types of properties.

At Hay Al Rahbah, we offer all the three critical pillars of the real estate industry: Property Management, Facilities Management and Property Consultation, while satisfying the immediate requirements of a growing market.

Our Property Management activities are an all-encompassing service towards both owners and tenants, and address all property concerns including valuations, planning, design, rent collection and review. These activities also include comprehensive project planning and consultation towards routine building maintenance as well as refurbishment and reconstruction projects for dated properties. With the client always being our primary focus, all property management activities are specifically customized towards individual personal needs or business requirements.

With all real estate initiatives comes a critical need for general and preventive building maintenance. Our in-house Facilities Management branch of Hay Al Rahbah provides access to highly skilled maintenance technicians, landscapers and security personnel to ensure all properties are maintained against the highest standards of class and quality. We provide services ranging from air-conditioning, electrical, mechanical and general maintenance, to garden landscaping and security services and our clients receive a unique opportunity to satisfy all real estate requirements simply through a single source provider. In the last two decades, we have developed and maintained over a thousand apartments, villas and town houses. Our strength lies in the fact that we work with a focus on the client´s interests. Our in-house maintenance team is available at hand to take care of all the plumbing, electrical and civil maintenance jobs of our clients quickly and efficiently. This has earned us a wide client base and a robust reputation for reliability and integrity.

news.title: EDECS and Assarain Group awarded the EZAD dry port and veterinary quarantine
news.summary: OPAZ awarded the dry port and veterinary quarantine at the Economic Zone at Al Dhahirah to EDECS, with Assarain Group as local partner.
body: The Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ) awarded EDECS the development of a dry port and veterinary quarantine at the Economic Zone at Al Dhahirah (EZAD) in Ibri. Assarain Group, also known as Said Salem Al Wahaibi Group, is the local partner in Oman.
The zone covers about 388 km² and lies roughly 20 km from the Rub Al Khali border crossing. Press coverage quoted Assarain Group Chairman Sheikh Salem bin Said Al Wahaibi.
Construction Business News Middle East, Container News and Gulf Construction also reported the award in May 2026.

news.title: RO 73 million in agreements signed for A'Dhahirah Special Economic Zone
news.summary: The third package, RO 48.058 million for dry port infrastructure and the veterinary quarantine, goes to a coalition that includes Assarain International Contracting.
body: Oman signed agreements worth RO 73 million for projects in the A'Dhahirah Special Economic Zone.

According to The Arabian Stories, the third package, worth RO 48.058 million and covering dry port infrastructure and the veterinary quarantine, will be built by a coalition of EDECS International Contracting, EDECS-KSA, EDECS Egypt and Assarain International Contracting Company.

The latest upgrade, ordered in September 2024, extended an existing finishing line at the Dubai plant.

news.title: Assarain Group and EDECS sign a strategic partnership
news.summary: Signed on 12 February 2025 at the Mandarin Hotel, Muscat, by Board Chairman Salem bin Said Al Wahaibi and Eng. Hussein El Dessouky of EDECS.
body: Assarain Group and EDECS signed a strategic partnership aimed at Oman's construction industry, Muscat Daily reported.

The agreement was signed by Salem bin Said Al Wahaibi, Board Chairman of Assarain Group, and Eng. Hussein El Dessouky of EDECS, under the patronage of the Undersecretary for Transport at the Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology. The event took place on 12 February 2025 at the Mandarin Hotel in Muscat.

The tournament is sponsored by the Assarain Group of Companies and was co-sponsored by Mistal and The Body Shop. Group Director Ibrahim Al Wahaibi was quoted in the coverage.

news.title: ACP signs a 25-year land lease in Duqm
news.summary: A renewable lease for a 60,000 m² plot with Duqm Industrial Land Company, a subsidiary of Port of Duqm Company.
body: Assarain Concrete Products (Duqm) LLC signed a 25-year renewable land lease for a 60,000 m² plot with Duqm Industrial Land Company, a subsidiary of Port of Duqm Company, Technical Review Middle East reported.
The site is intended for a concrete block plant serving the Duqm region.

news.title: ACP hosts a symposium on advances in concrete technology
news.summary: A half-day symposium at the Grand Hyatt Muscat with speakers from the American Concrete Institute.
body: Assarain Concrete Products hosted a half-day symposium on advances in concrete technology at the Grand Hyatt Muscat, described as the first of its kind in Oman, with speakers from the American Concrete Institute.
The report is archived on the ACP news page.

news.title: ACP named best concrete products manufacturer
news.summary: ACP won 'Best manufacturer of construction materials, concrete products' at a ceremony on 17 September 2014.
body: Assarain Concrete Products was named Best Manufacturer of Construction Materials, Concrete Products, at a ceremony at the InterContinental Muscat on 17 September 2014.
Khalid Said Al Wahaibi received the award on behalf of the company.

faq.a: A Muscat-based trading and investment group, founded in 1975 and part of the Said Salem Al Wahaibi (SSW) Group of Companies.

faq.q: How many companies are in the Group?
faq.a: assarain.com says 19+. Its English pages list 17 companies across four divisions, and its Arabic pages list four more: Strabag Oman, Blue Falcon Travel, Wadi Adai Auto Service Centre and Al Haq Trading.

faq.q: Which sectors does it work in?
faq.a: Manufacturing (concrete, steel, plastics), construction, maintenance and property, retail and consumer services (furnishing, insurance, beauty retail, healthcare, menswear, facility services) and food distribution.
Across Oman, with offices and plants in Muscat, Rusayl, Sohar and Salalah, and in the UAE through Alserkal & Assarain Concrete Products in Dubai.

faq.q: How do I contact the head office?
faq.a: Call +968 2460 4811 or email business@assarain.com. The postal address is PO Box 1475, PC 112, Ruwi, Muscat.

faq.q: How do I apply for a job?
faq.a: Use the Apply Online form on assarain.com: name, position, phone, email, years of experience and your CV. No vacancies are listed on the site.

confirm: Chairman: assarain.com still names Lt. Col. Said Salem Al Wahaibi as Chairman; an obituary says he died in October 2020 and 2025–2026 press names Sheikh Salem bin Said Al Wahaibi as Chairman. This site follows the press. Confirm the current leadership and how the founder should be referred to.
assarain.com refers to Sultan Qaboos bin Said as the current ruler on several pages; those passages were left out. Confirm any wording about His Majesty Sultan Haitham bin Tarik.

Company count: the site says 19+ companies; the English navigation lists 17 entities and Arabic-only pages list 4 more (Strabag Oman, Blue Falcon Travel, Wadi Adai Auto Service Centre, Al Haq Trading). Confirm which of the 21 are current.

The Our Business Groups page still lists Cluttons & Partners LLC and Hatat Polyclinic LLC; the menu uses Savills and Partners Oman and Hatat Specialty Clinics. This site uses the newer names. Hatat Complex page still says it is managed by Cluttons.
Stats '40+ years', '2+ countries', '4000+ employees' are from an undated page (around 2017). Years are shown as years since 1975. Confirm employee numbers.

Company facts (capacities, 10 The Body Shop stores, 2,800 Kalhat staff, 23 trucks, 2,000 managed units, 1,000 KONE units in 12 months) come from company pages last edited around 2017–2020. Confirm they are current.
No map coordinates are published for any office, plant or clinic. Branch maps search by name and area; confirm exact pins. Opening hours are not published.
ACP factory location (PO Box 971, CPO) and the Duqm plant (construction began 2019) are not described on the site; not shown as locations.
News: assarain.com has no news section. All articles come from third-party press (dated) and the ACP news archive. Gulf Construction Online article date inferred from its image path (27 May 2026).
News photos are the Group's own file photos, not photos of the events.

Hatat Specialty Clinics photos on assarain.com are stock images; this site uses stills from the Assarain corporate film instead. Strabag Oman and Al Haq Trading images are as published on assarain.com and may be stock.
Arabic-only company summaries (Strabag Oman, Blue Falcon Travel, Wadi Adai Auto Service Centre, Al Haq Trading) are translated from Arabic; check the wording.
